description: Microsoft Azure is a cloud computing service created by Microsoft for building, testing, deploying, and managing applications and services.
painPoints: Complex pricing structure, easy to overspend
Portal can be slow and confusing

alternatives.name: AWS
alternatives.reason: Market leader, broader service catalog, more mature ecosystem

alternatives.name: Google Cloud
alternatives.reason: Strong in data analytics, machine learning, and Kubernetes

alternatives.name: DigitalOcean
alternatives.reason: Simpler pricing, easier to use, great for small projects
alternatives.pricing: From $4/month; Free credits for new users

migrationGuide: Use infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) to provision resources in the new cloud. For lift-and-shift, use cloud migration tools like Azure Migrate (to Azure) or AWS Migration Hub. Plan for 3-12 months.
verdict: AWS is best for enterprise and broadest services. Google Cloud is best for data/ML workloads. DigitalOcean is best for simplicity and cost.

faqs.question: How hard is it to migrate from Azure to AWS?
faqs.answer: It's a major project. Use Terraform to recreate infrastructure. For data migration, use AWS DataSync or Azure Data Factory.

faqs.question: Is DigitalOcean cheaper than Azure?
faqs.answer: For small projects, yes. DigitalOcean has transparent, simple pricing. Azure can get expensive with bandwidth and managed services.

description: Docker is a set of platform-as-a-service products that use OS-level virtualization to deliver software in packages called containers.
painPoints: Docker Desktop requires paid subscription for large companies

alternatives.name: Podman
alternatives.reason: Daemonless, rootless containers, Docker-compatible CLI, no subscription

alternatives.name: LXC/LXD
alternatives.reason: System containers (lighter than VMs, more isolated than Docker)

alternatives.name: Containerd
alternatives.reason: Lightweight container runtime, used by Kubernetes, no CLI by default

migrationGuide: Podman has a `podman-docker` wrapper that makes it a drop-in replacement for Docker CLI. For Docker Compose, Podman supports `podman-compose`. Migrating images: re-pull from registries or save/load images.
verdict: Podman is the best direct replacement for Docker Desktop (no subscription fee). LXC is better for system containers. Containerd is better for Kubernetes clusters.

faqs.question: Is Podman really free for enterprise?
faqs.answer: Yes, Podman is open-source and free. No subscription required, unlike Docker Desktop for large companies.

faqs.question: Can I run my Docker Compose files with Podman?
faqs.answer: Yes, use `podman-compose` which is compatible with Docker Compose files.

description: Kubernetes is an open-source container orchestration system for automating software deployment, scaling, and management.
painPoints: Extremely complex to set up and maintain

alternatives.name: Docker Swarm
alternatives.reason: Simpler orchestration, integrated with Docker, easier to set up

alternatives.name: Nomad
alternatives.reason: Simpler than Kubernetes, supports containers and non-container workloads

alternatives.name: Amazon ECS
alternatives.reason: AWS-native container orchestration, no control plane to manage

migrationGuide: For Docker Swarm, use `docker stack deploy`. For Nomad, convert Kubernetes YAML to HCL (Nomad jobs). For ECS, use `ecs-cli compose` to deploy Docker Compose files. Full migration typically takes 1-3 months.
verdict: Docker Swarm is best for simple Docker-native orchestration. Nomad is best for mixed workloads. ECS is best for AWS-centric teams.

faqs.question: Is Docker Swarm easier than Kubernetes?
faqs.answer: Yes, much easier. If you're already using Docker, Swarm is built-in and simple to set up.

faqs.question: Can Nomad run Kubernetes workloads?
faqs.answer: Not directly. You need to convert Kubernetes YAML manifests to Nomad HCL job files.

description: Adobe Illustrator is a vector graphics editor and design program developed and marketed by Adobe Inc.

alternatives.name: Inkscape
alternatives.reason: Free, open-source vector graphics editor, capable alternative

alternatives.name: Affinity Designer
alternatives.reason: One-time purchase ($69.99), professional-grade, fast

alternatives.name: Figma
alternatives.reason: Free tier, web-based, excellent for UI/vector design, real-time collaboration

migrationGuide: Export Illustrator files as SVG for Inkscape. For Affinity Designer, import AI or PDF files. For Figma, export as SVG or import directly (Figma supports AI files).
verdict: Inkscape is best for free, open-source vector editing. Affinity Designer is best for one-time purchase. Figma is best for UI/collaborative design.

faqs.question: Can Inkscape open AI files?
faqs.answer: Yes, Inkscape can open AI files (legacy format) and PDF exports from Illustrator.

faqs.question: Is Affinity Designer a one-time purchase?
faqs.answer: Yes, Affinity Designer is a one-time purchase (usually $69.99, often on sale). No subscription.

description: Adobe InDesign is a desktop publishing and typesetting software application produced by Adobe Inc.

alternatives.name: Scribus
alternatives.reason: Free, open-source desktop publishing, capable alternative

alternatives.name: Affinity Publisher
alternatives.reason: One-time purchase ($69.99), professional-grade, fast

alternatives.name: QuarkXPress
alternatives.reason: One-time purchase, long-standing InDesign competitor

migrationGuide: Export InDesign files as IDML for Affinity Publisher import. For Scribus, export as PDF and re-import. For QuarkXPress, use IDML import (Quark supports InDesign IDML files).
verdict: Scribus is best for free, open-source publishing. Affinity Publisher is best for one-time purchase. QuarkXPress is best for legacy Quark users.

faqs.question: Can Affinity Publisher open InDesign files?
faqs.answer: Affinity Publisher can import InDesign IDML files (File → Open → select IDML).

faqs.question: Is Scribus as powerful as InDesign?
faqs.answer: Scribus is capable but has a steeper learning curve and fewer features than InDesign. It's suitable for many publishing needs.

description: Microsoft Project is a project management software product, developed and sold by Microsoft.
painPoints: Very expensive ($10/user/month for Project Plan 1, $30 for Plan 3)
Complex and overwhelming for simple projects

alternatives.name: GanttPRO
alternatives.reason: Intuitive Gantt chart interface, easier than Project, cloud-based

alternatives.name: Asana
alternatives.reason: Free tier, includes timeline (Gantt-like) view, better for agile teams

alternatives.name: Smartsheet
alternatives.reason: Spreadsheet-style project management, familiar interface, powerful automations

migrationGuide: Export Microsoft Project files as XML. Import into GanttPRO, Asana (timeline), or Smartsheet. For simple projects, recreate the task list in the new tool.
verdict: GanttPRO is best for dedicated Gantt chart users. Asana is best for agile teams. Smartsheet is best for spreadsheet-style project management.

faqs.question: Can I open Microsoft Project files in GanttPRO?
faqs.answer: Yes, GanttPRO can import Microsoft Project XML files.

faqs.question: Does Asana have Gantt charts?
faqs.answer: Yes, Asana's Timeline view is a Gantt-like view. It's available in the free tier with limitations.

description: Adobe Lightroom is a family of image organization and image manipulation software developed by Adobe Inc.
painPoints: Requires cloud sync (Local storage options limited)

alternatives.name: Capture One
alternatives.reason: Professional-grade RAW processing, excellent color handling

alternatives.name: darktable
alternatives.reason: Free, open-source RAW processor and organizer, Lightroom alternative

alternatives.name: Luminar Neo
alternatives.reason: AI-powered editing, one-time purchase option, easier than Lightroom

migrationGuide: Export Lightroom catalogs as folder hierarchies with develop settings applied. For Capture One, import by referencing original RAW files. For darktable, point to your RAW file folders.
verdict: Capture One is best for professional photographers wanting color precision. darktable is best for free, open-source RAW processing. Luminar Neo is best for AI-powered quick edits.

faqs.question: Can darktable open Lightroom catalogs?
faqs.answer: Not directly. You need to export your photos as RAW + XMP sidecar files from Lightroom, then import into darktable.

faqs.question: Is Capture One a subscription?
faqs.answer: Capture One offers both subscription ($15/month) and one-time purchase ($299) options.

description: Sublime Text is a proprietary cross-platform source code editor with a Python application programming interface.
painPoints: Free version has persistent nagware popup
Plugin ecosystem not as rich as VS Code
Paid license required for continued use ($99)

alternatives.name: VS Code
alternatives.reason: Free, open-source, massive extension marketplace, excellent debugger

alternatives.name: Vim
alternatives.reason: Free, open-source, keyboard-centric, extremely fast

alternatives.name: Neovim
alternatives.reason: Modern Vim fork, better extensibility, LSP support

migrationGuide: For VS Code, install your preferred extensions. For Vim/Neovim, learn the modal editing model. Your Sublime Text keybindings can be recreated in VS Code with the 'Sublime Text Keymap' extension.
verdict: VS Code is the best all-around alternative. Vim/Neovim are best for keyboard-centric workflows. All are free unlike Sublime Text's nagware.

faqs.question: Is VS Code really free?
faqs.answer: Yes, VS Code is free and open-source (MIT license). Microsoft provides the pre-built binaries for free.

faqs.question: Can I use Sublime Text keybindings in VS Code?
faqs.answer: Yes, install the 'Sublime Text Keymap and Settings Importer' extension in VS Code.

description: IntelliJ IDEA is an integrated development environment written in Java for developing computer software.
painPoints: Expensive ($169/year for first year, $135 for second)
Paid license required for Ultimate edition

alternatives.name: VS Code
alternatives.reason: Free, lightweight, excellent Java extensions (Extension Pack for Java)

alternatives.name: Eclipse
alternatives.reason: Free, open-source Java IDE, long-standing IntelliJ competitor

alternatives.name: NetBeans
alternatives.reason: Free, open-source, Apache project, good for Java SE/EE

migrationGuide: Export IntelliJ project settings. For VS Code, installExtension Pack for Java. For Eclipse, import existing Maven/Gradle projects. For NetBeans, open the project folder.
verdict: VS Code is best for lightweight Java development with extensions. Eclipse is best for traditional Java EE. NetBeans is best for Apache project integration.

faqs.question: Is VS Code as powerful as IntelliJ for Java?
faqs.answer: With the Extension Pack for Java, VS Code is very capable. IntelliJ still has more advanced refactoring tools.

faqs.question: Can I import IntelliJ projects into Eclipse?
faqs.answer: Yes, Eclipse can import existing Maven/Gradle projects. For plain IntelliJ projects, create a new Eclipse project and link the source folders.

description: Discord Nitro is a paid subscription for Discord that unlocks premium features like server boosts, custom emojis, and higher upload limits.
painPoints: Server boosting is expensive ($4.99/month per boost)
Not all users need the premium features

alternatives.name: Discord (Free)
alternatives.reason: Core Discord functionality is free, Nitro adds nice-to-have features

alternatives.name: Slack (Free)
alternatives.reason: Free tier for small teams, different use case than Discord

alternatives.name: TeamSpeak
alternatives.reason: Free voice chat, long-standing Discord alternative, self-hosted servers

migrationGuide: Nitro is an add-on, not a standalone tool. To cancel Nitro, go to Discord settings → Subscriptions → Cancel. You'll revert to free tier.
verdict: Most users don't need Nitro. The free Discord tier is sufficient for most communities. Consider Nitro only if you want server boosts or higher upload limits.

faqs.question: What do I lose if I cancel Discord Nitro?
faqs.answer: You lose: higher upload limit (50MB → 8MB), server boosts, custom emojis across servers, and Nitro badge.

faqs.question: Is Discord Nitro worth it?
faqs.answer: Only if you actively use server boosts or need the higher upload limit. For most users, free tier is sufficient.

description: TeamViewer is a proprietary software application for remote control, desktop sharing, online meetings, web conferencing, and file transfer between computers.
painPoints: Expensive for commercial use (detects commercial use and blocks)
Free version has limitations and session timeouts

alternatives.name: AnyDesk
alternatives.reason: Faster performance, free for personal use, portable version available

alternatives.name: RustDesk
alternatives.reason: Free, open-source, self-hostable, no subscription

alternatives.name: Chrome Remote Desktop
alternatives.reason: Completely free, web-based, uses Google account

migrationGuide: Install the alternative on both computers. For RustDesk, set up self-hosted relay server for privacy. For Chrome Remote Desktop, just install the Chrome extension.
verdict: AnyDesk is best for performance. RustDesk is best for open-source and self-hosting. Chrome Remote Desktop is best for simple, free access.

faqs.question: Is RustDesk really free?
faqs.answer: Yes, RustDesk is open-source and free. You can use their cloud relay (free) or self-host your own.

faqs.question: Does Chrome Remote Desktop work on mobile?
faqs.answer: Yes, Chrome Remote Desktop has Android and iOS apps for remote access.

description: AnyDesk is a remote desktop software application that allows users to access and control computers remotely.
painPoints: Free version limited to personal use (detects commercial use)
Paid plans are expensive for small businesses

alternatives.name: RustDesk
alternatives.reason: Free, open-source, self-hostable, no commercial use detection

alternatives.name: TeamViewer
alternatives.reason: Well-known alternative, but also expensive for commercial use

alternatives.name: VNC Connect (RealVNC)
alternatives.reason: Established VNC technology, free for personal use

migrationGuide: Install RustDesk on both computers. For self-hosting, set up your own relay server. Export AnyDesk address book (if paid) and re-add contacts in the new tool.
verdict: RustDesk is the best free, open-source alternative. VNC Connect is best for established VNC workflows. TeamViewer is an option but also expensive.

faqs.question: Is RustDesk better than AnyDesk?
faqs.answer: RustDesk is free and open-source with no commercial use restrictions. AnyDesk has a more polished UI but restricts free use.

faqs.question: Can I self-host RustDesk?
faqs.answer: Yes, RustDesk provides Docker images and documentation for self-hosting the relay server.

description: Adobe Acrobat Pro is a family of application software and web services developed by Adobe Inc. to view, create, manipulate, print and manage files in PDF.
painPoints: Bloated software with many features most users don't need

alternatives.name: PDF24
alternatives.reason: Free, web-based PDF tools, no installation, privacy-friendly

alternatives.name: LibreOffice Draw
alternatives.reason: Free, open-source PDF editor, can annotate and edit PDFs

alternatives.name: PDF-XChange Editor
alternatives.reason: One-time purchase option, fast performance, many features

migrationGuide: No migration needed for PDF tools. Install the alternative and open your PDF files. For advanced features (OCR, form creation), check if the alternative supports them.
verdict: PDF24 is best for free, web-based PDF tools. LibreOffice Draw is best for free, open-source PDF editing. PDF-XChange Editor is best for one-time purchase.

faqs.question: Can LibreOffice Draw edit PDFs like Acrobat?
faqs.answer: LibreOffice Draw can open and edit PDFs, but complex layouts may not preserve perfectly. For advanced editing, PDF-XChange Editor is better.

faqs.question: Is PDF24 completely free?
faqs.answer: Yes, PDF24's web-based tools are completely free. They also have a free Windows desktop version.

description: Microsoft Visio is a diagramming and vector graphics application and is part of the Microsoft Office family.

alternatives.name: draw.io (diagrams.net)
alternatives.reason: Completely free, web-based, no registration, excellent Visio alternative

alternatives.name: Lucidchart
alternatives.reason: Modern web-based diagramming, easier to use than Visio, collaboration features

alternatives.name: OmniGraffle
alternatives.reason: Mac-only, one-time purchase, excellent for diagrams and wireframing

migrationGuide: Export Visio files as VSDX. Import into draw.io (diagrams.net) or Lucidchart. Both support Visio file import. For OmniGraffle, import VSDX files.
verdict: draw.io is the best free, open-source alternative. Lucidchart is best for web-based collaboration. OmniGraffle is best for Mac users.

faqs.question: Can draw.io open Visio files?
faqs.answer: Yes, draw.io can import Visio VSDX and VSD files.

faqs.question: Is Lucidchart free like draw.io?
faqs.answer: Lucidchart has a free tier with limitations (60 objects per document). draw.io is completely free with no limits.

description: MindManager is a commercial mind mapping and brainstorming software developed by Corel.
painPoints: Windows and Mac versions are separate purchases

alternatives.name: XMind
alternatives.reason: Modern UI, free version available, cross-platform

alternatives.name: FreeMind
alternatives.reason: Free, open-source mind mapping, simple and effective

alternatives.name: Miro
alternatives.reason: Web-based collaborative whiteboard, includes mind mapping, generous free tier

migrationGuide: Export MindManager maps as MMAP or XML. Import into XMind (supports MMAP import). For FreeMind, export as MM format. For Miro, rebuild the mind map using Miro's mind map template.
verdict: XMind is best for a modern mind mapping experience. FreeMind is best for free, open-source. Miro is best for collaborative brainstorming.

faqs.question: Can XMind open MindManager files?
faqs.answer: Yes, XMind can import MindManager MMAP files.

faqs.question: Is Miro a mind mapping tool?
faqs.answer: Miro is a collaborative whiteboard that includes mind mapping templates. It's more than just a mind mapping tool.
